race.comment: LITLMAX (3) made a solid impact on debut two-and-a-half weeks ago, finishing second and beaten 9 metres over 2190m at this track. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. Meets a comparable field so she is capable of getting the job done. LATHER WITH FIRE (5) finished eighth two runs ago then broke and finished a distant fourth over 2190m at this track at the latest appearance. Only needs to get things right to be in contention. CRUEL MISTRESS (6) is in the mix following a respectable third at her most recent appearance over 2190m at this track. ELISSAS DELIGHT (4) is the best of the rest after finishing fourth over 2190m at this track last time out.
